title: Offshore Giant Tidewater Deepens Brazil Push With Strategic All-Cash Acquisition
author: Akanksha Bakshi
description: Tidewater Inc. announced a definitive agreement to acquire Wilson Sons Ultratug Participações S.A. and Atlantic Offshore Services S.A. for approximately $500 million in cash. The acquisition will expand Tidewater's Brazilian offshore vessel fleet from 6 to 28 vessels and its global fleet to 231 vessels. WSUT is expected to generate $220 million in revenue with a 58% gross margin in the first 12 months post-closing, with the deal expected to boost earnings and cash flow per share in 2026 and 2027.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: The acquisition significantly expands Tidewater's presence in the Brazilian offshore market, one of the largest globally. The deal is expected to boost earnings and cash flow per share, add substantial revenue ($220M annually), and provide access to locally-built PSVs and REB tonnage rights. The company maintains strong financial position with net leverage below 1.0x post-closing and benefits from low-cost, long-term financing.

title: Investing Tips From Market-Crushing Fund Manager Who Delivered Over 4X Returns Than S&P 500 Over 32 Years: From Choosing Undervalued Stocks To His Best Trades Ever And More - Benzinga
author: Navdeep Yadav
description: Bob Robotti, a veteran fund manager, has consistently outperformed the S&P 500 over the past 32 years. He shares his investment strategies, including identifying undervalued companies and patiently waiting for their rebound, as well as insights into one of his most successful trades.

insights.sentiment_reasoning: Robotti's investment in Tidewater, an oil services firm, has been a successful trade, with the stock price increasing from $14 to over $90 per share in three years.
